title: Effects of Snack Types on Acute Glucose and Insulin Response
official: Effects of Snack Types on Acute Glucose and Insulin Response
summary: The purpose of the present study was to determine the effects of different type of snack consumption on postprandial satiety, glucose, insulin, antioxidant capacity and anxiety in healthy subjects.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18-55 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smoker
* Pregnant woman
* Required dietary supplement use
* Required medication of metabolic disorders
* Allergy to nuts or gluten (wheat)

sites.f: School of Exercise and Nutritional Sciences, SDSU
